decisions.statement: The full pass repairs the minutely poll.
A transaction always has an account to name.
Only the tags the fetched transactions actually have are landed.
A failing account does not stop the other accounts.
Every failure is caught and named.
The run ends non-zero once every account has been tried.
Our copy is compared against Monarch after the landing rather than before.
A comparison that cannot be made is said and does not stop the run.
A row claimed by more than one rule leaves the run non-zero after everything else is done.

definition: the whole of Monarch copied, compared against itself, and the rules run over what arrived
